description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the netfilter connection tracking extension structure (nf_ct_ext). When a tracked connection is destroyed while an nftables expression still holds a reference to the extension, the extension structure is freed but the stale reference is not cleared. Subsequent evaluation of the nftables expression dereferences a function pointer within the freed object, leading to potential control-flow hijacking.

dereference_offsets.context: The kernel calls the function pointer at offset 192 of the freed nf_ct_ext structure when evaluating an nft_ct expression during packet processing.
